answer: Each reputation contribution decays exponentially at a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. A newly spawned Sybil has negligible incoming trust and near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed endorsements, and consensus thresholds exclude reputation-free nodes. It cannot leap the ledge into an orchard of trusted peers by planting a garden of identities.
